description: Use this when someone wants a person nearby to do a job, e.g. "someone to mow my lawn in Dallas", "a handyman near me", "help moving a couch", "who can clean my house in Orlando". Finds a real person near them in the US who does a kind of home job or errand: assembly, yard work, cleaning, moving help, hauling, small repairs, pickups. Searches locals on GigNGo by service and place. Returns public profiles: name, bio, skills, prices the local set, reviews, whether they filmed their work (filmedTheirWork, workVideoCount), neighbor vouches, service area and profile URL. With a city, locals listed on that town's GigNGo area page come first (relation "in", "serves" or "nearby", with miles), then locals in that town, ordered so those who filmed their work come first. Each local carries `clips` (up to 2 videos of their work: watch link, still, and before and after stills where we have them), so you can show the work without another call, and `whyListed` (the plain facts that put them there; `howOrdered` explains the order; paying never moves a local higher). Badges are self-reported. Pass the person's own words: service like "lawn mowing" or "house-cleaning", and the place as `where` like "Saginaw, MI" (or `state` and `city`). `searchedFor` says how the words were read. Returns up to `limit` locals per page.

city.description: Optional. City name, e.g. "San Francisco" or "san-francisco".

service.description: The job in plain words or a category slug, e.g. "lawn mowing", "move a couch", "house-cleaning".

state.description: Optional. US state name or code, e.g. "new-york", "New York", "NY".

where.description: Optional. The place as typed, e.g. "Saginaw, MI", "Silver Spring, Maryland", "Ohio".

name: search_local_workers
title: Find locals
